verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a passing mention that agents have 'their own audit trail' alongside keys and channel memberships, which hints at some logging of agent actions but says nothing about a queryable/reviewable log covering both admin and human user actions across the workspace, nor any export/compliance tooling.
